verdict.rationale: Adyen documents 'payment links' as a way to accept payments without building custom UI, and its Sessions API can drive a hosted redirect flow, but the evidence pack gives no dedicated hosted-checkout-page documentation, conversion-optimization claims, or hands-on confirmation of ease-of-use — and community feedback repeatedly flags Adyen's integration as more complex/'bare metal' compared to turnkey competitors. missing for 10: dedicated hosted checkout page docs, conversion-rate optimization evidence, independent confirmation of a no-code redirect flow working smoothly.
